mapper.select: WITH kinds AS ( SELECT 'A' AS trans_kind UNION SELECT 'B' UNION SELECT 'C' UNION SELECT 'D' UNION SELECT 'E' ) SELECT COUNT(t.trans_kind) AS count FROM kinds k LEFT JOIN `project` t ON k.trans_kind = t.trans_kind GROUP BY k.trans_kind;

WITH kinds AS ( SELECT 'A' AS trans_kind UNION SELECT 'C' UNION SELECT 'B' UNION SELECT 'D' UNION SELECT 'E' ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.sum_success_price), 0) AS total_amount FROM kinds k LEFT JOIN `project` t ON k.trans_kind = t.trans_kind GROUP BY k.trans_kind
SELECT trans_kind, sum_success_price, area FROM project WHERE sum_success_price IS NOT NULL AND area IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN project_status = '鉴证打印' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified_count FROM project;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(sum_success_price) AS sumSuccessPrice, SUM(area) AS area FROM project
SELECT trans_kind, COALESCE(SUM(sum_success_price), 0) AS sum_success_price FROM project GROUP BY trans_kind ORDER BY trans_kind ASC;
